# S4.1 — the component-variation registry service (C1): multi-namespace `hh`/`local`/`exp/<id>`/reverse-DNS grammar with signer ownership by *verified* attestation, third-party publish/deprecate/yank/revoke with append-only revocation propagation, general `import`/`export` over a closed foreign-system vocabulary with structured loss reports, `publisher_claim` at `review`, strict `probed` (R-2.10.2)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §6.2 (the C1/Stage-4 registry-service delta)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/062_S4.1__registry-service.md` (sequence 62 of 106)
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.10.2**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s3.12b` (stacked @ `8fee75c` — GATE-G2
PASSED, Stage 4 released) · **Stage:** 4 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only — all verification in-tree/hermetic; no
network egress, no foreign toolchains, no external spend
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0292-s4.1-registry-service-rulings.md`
**Deferrals:** none opened or closed — every OPEN/PARTIAL row re-read;
none are scoped to the §6.2 delta

## Summary

**The namespace grammar is a closed sum, not a prefix check.**
`hh_identity::names::Namespace` is now `{Hh, Local, Experiment(String),
Shared(String)}` (non-`Copy`): `exp/<experiment_id>` under a
single-segment id grammar, shared namespaces under a reverse-DNS
grammar (≥ 2 letter-led dot-separated labels). A bare one-label foreign
name refuses to parse; `(namespace, name)` uniqueness across kinds and
the append-only name index are unchanged.

**Signer ownership is proven, never claimed (CC2).**
`NamespaceRecord.owners` may name `SignerRef`s/`PrincipalRef`s, but
signer ownership is honoured only when the acting registrar's
`Signature`/`Pin` attestation verifies under the union of
`accepted_signers` over the live (admissible, unrevoked)
`TrustRootPolicy` records — a quarantined trust policy anchors nothing.
`publish`/`deprecate`/`yank`/`revoke` are authorized by namespace
ownership; `revoke` of another publisher's version needs a namespace
owner or ≥ `principal` administrator (AC-R-2.10.2-10's authorization
half).

**Third-party variants resolve — at `hash_only_ceiling`, confined.**
Unsigned out-of-process third-party variants register `resolved` with
`summary.authority ≤ external` (a hash-only pin is integrity, never
endorsement); `in_process` stays `LocalityInadmissible` for every
non-first-party registrar. A declared authority above the lowest live
ceiling refuses without a verified signer attestation. Kinds/namespaces
matching `require_signature_for`/`require_signature` register
`quarantined` until a verified `pin` — implemented as a two-phase
commit: a `lifecycle.registry.pin_subject` anchor row carries the
subject-side quarantined label, then the `security.label.endorsed` row
rewrites `subject_ref` to the committed anchor (the endorsement's
subject must resolve at append).

**`import`/`export` are general governed heads.** `ForeignRef{system ∈
{acp_registry, mcp_registry, marketplace, git, archive}, locator,
digest?, label?}` narrows through `policy.allowed_foreign_systems`
(fail-closed empty default); every admitted document registers a
quarantined `foreign_import` with a five-bucket `LossReport`
(`capabilities | conformance | trust_legs | digest | other`; the legacy
array form decodes into `other` — CC8; nothing silently dropped — CC3).
ACP `agent.json` lifts to a participant-descriptor candidate, never a
variant. `export` targets the closed `plugin_manifest/1`; emitted
documents re-decode through `manifest_from_json` before leaving, and
export→import of a first-party variant recovers every non-lost field
(AC-R-2.10.2-11).

**Revocation propagates, never hides.** `revoke` appends a
`RevocationRecord`; `resolve(execute)` refuses the revoked version and
every sealed definition in its `StaleIndex`, while audit/read
projections keep the rows annotated `depends_on_revoked`
(AC-R-2.10.2-10).

**`publisher_claim` is review evidence, never coverage.** Claims are
admitted and surface in `lineage`/`publisher_claims`, but strict
`probed` reads only admissible, non-stale `registry_ci`/`lab` reports
with durable run references (ADR-0152 D3).

**Boundary (Group L).** `lab.registry.import` dispatches the
`{foreign_ref, document}` head alongside the `{listing}` path;
`lab.registry.export`, `lab.registry.pin`, and
`lab.registry.publisher_claims` are live ops (ops metadata flipped;
generated client + schema export regenerated — `schema_hash` moved,
drift check holds).

## Tests

- `crates/hh-registry/tests/s4_1.rs` — 11 tests, all green:
  `ac9_third_party_out_of_process_resolves_in_process_refused`,
  `ac9_signature_required_quarantines_until_pin`,
  `ac9_publisher_claim_never_probed`,
  `ac10_revocation_blocks_execute_keeps_visibility`,
  `ac10_revoke_authorization`,
  `ac11_foreign_imports_quarantined_with_loss_reports`,
  `ac11_export_round_trip_preserves_every_non_lost_field`,
  `signer_ownership_gates_shared_namespace`,
  `require_signature_namespace_gates_publish`,
  `experiment_and_principal_owned_namespaces`,
  `import_and_pin_emit_lifecycle_events`.
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/conformance.rs` —
  `lab_registry_foreign_import_export_pin_round_trip` (foreign-ref
  import head → typed `ForeignSystemRefused` under the fail-closed
  default policy; `pin` on a non-quarantined record → typed refusal;
  `publisher_claims` → `{claims:[]}`; `export` → a
  `plugin_manifest/1` document re-decoded through
  `manifest_from_json`; unknown target → typed refusal) +
  `lab_registry_gates_still_hold` amended (`export` is live — a
  malformed call refuses `SchemaViolation`, never `stage_pending`).
- Pre-existing `hh-registry` tests amended for the sanctioned
  behaviour changes (ADR-0292 D3/D5): `ForeignImport.loss_report` is
  the structured `LossReport`, and third-party unsigned-confined
  variants `resolve` instead of quarantining.

## Out of scope

Live foreign-registry fetches (network transport), `oci_image/1` and
other export targets (closed vocabulary refused typed), marketplace/git
lift depth beyond the declared loss buckets.
